[policy:POL-2024-0001] Policy POL-2024-0001 is a fictional motor policy. Report accidental vehicle damage within 7 days. Submit photographs and a repair estimate. A claim status is administrative progress, not a coverage decision.
[policy:POL-2024-0002] Policy POL-2024-0002 is a fictional home policy. Report escape-of-water damage within 14 days. Submit photographs and the plumber's report. An adjuster must review the evidence before a coverage decision.
